address: ABC Brickworks Market & Food Centre, #01-132, Blk 6 Jalan Bukit Merah, 150006, Singapore
bio: Its bak chor mee can be made with your choice of noodles – mee pok being the most popular. Bouncy noodles are dressed in sambal and topped with sliced pork and meatballs. Also try the noodle soup with fish balls or pork liver....
